text: {"reply":"Please don't drive the car. A grinding noise with a brake warning light may mean it isn't safe, and I can't tell you what is wrong or that it's safe to drive. The earlier message about driving slowly to Vaughan was wrong. If anyone is hurt or in danger, call 911. Otherwise, please arrange a tow or a ride. A person from our team will review your request urgently. Whether this is covered is decided by the warranty desk after an inspection, so I can't promise coverage. Once I've verified you, I can also send a warranty review request. What is your last name, and your licence plate or repair-order number?","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"Customer reports grinding from the front right and a brake warning light on a 2021 Meridian Arbor. They asked whether to keep driving and whether it is covered by warranty. An earlier colleague message wrongly suggested driving to the branch, and the customer was told not to drive and to call 911 if anyone is in danger. The customer is not yet verified and no tools were run. Urgent safety follow-up and a warranty review are needed.","policy_rules_cited":["P07","P14","P05","P02","P13"]}
